description: This file contains a collection of helper functions, constants, and decorators for exporting PyTorch models to ONNX format, specifically targeting TorchScript representations. It includes functions for handling tensor attributes, converting between PyTorch and ONNX data types, graph manipulation, dequantization/quantization, and other utilities needed during model export.
